STATUS-001.summary: Replies to Closed tickets by email.
STATUS-001.was: Closed tickets were final and a customer reply opened a new ticket, but a widget visitor's emailed reply could land on a separate contact, a reply could join another open ticket of the customer's, and a teammate's emailed reply was handled like a customer's.
STATUS-001.now: The sender of mail to a Closed ticket is recognized exactly as on an open ticket, including a widget visitor answering through the reply address. Each customer reply opens a new ticket for that same customer, never joining another ticket of theirs. A teammate's emailed reply is refused: the Email Worker bounces it with the reason and SendGrid or the mail gateway sends the teammate one notice. Nothing is stored and no contact is made from their address. Time-based auto-close and linked follow-up tickets remain unimplemented.

MAIL-001.summary: Inbound mail identifies its sender before applying the Closed-ticket rule.
MAIL-001.was: Mail addressed to a Closed ticket took the new-ticket path before its sender was resolved against that ticket.
MAIL-001.now: The Email Worker, SendGrid Inbound Parse and JSON gateway resolve the sender against the Closed ticket (its reply address, requester, participants and preferred address) first, so customers, widget visitors and teammates receive the same outcome through each door. Teammate mail is refused with a bounce, or a 422 and one notice; redelivered mail is still received once.

agentUpdateInstructions: Update from v0.4.3 to v0.4.4 without resetting. Stop all writers and back up D1, R2 and Durable Object state and private settings. Install frozen dependencies with Node 22.20.0, pnpm 10.12.4 and @runeditrun/rer 0.2.45. v0.4.4 adds no migrations; replace the Worker and resume traffic. Older releases first apply every migration they lack in filename order, as listed in the v0.4.3 release: migrations 124_contact_email_proof_guard.sql and 126_restore_contact_erasure.sql bracket the immutable 125 backfill, and the identical runtime erasure trigger must be restored by 126 before writers resume. 125_contact_email_proof.sql changes only eligible unsigned widget contacts metadata_json to mark email_unproven=1; 129_owner_unassigned_alerts.sql enables is_notified_on_unassigned_activity for owners only where an active non-demo workspace has no alerted member. These documented migrations are intentional; every other original value is retained. Preserve owner credentials, native support history, permissions, imports and erasure fences. Keep uncertain external outcomes without replay and retain human Send.
publicReleaseNotes: HappyToHelp v0.4.4 handles email replies to Closed tickets: a customer's reply, including a widget visitor's through the reply address, opens a new ticket for that same customer, and a teammate's reply is refused with a bounce or notice and never stored. The 1,000-conversation import check now measures live memory after garbage collection. There are no new migrations; installations on v0.4.3 back up and replace the Worker. Commands use @runeditrun/rer 0.2.45. Hosted and paid-provider quality remain separately qualified; accessibility remains on owner HOLD. Production is separate and unchanged.
